card.name: Capital I starting a name or code
card.fires_on: The letter or short piece starting with capital I (I, Il, Ian, IE, Israel) right after a hyphen, comma, or space. It sits at the start of a name, acronym, or code in citations, author lists, and URLs.

modes.label: Author names
modes.description: An I-initial first name or initial inside an author or speaker list.
modes.example: Tae-<<Il>> Jeon, Bing Zhu and Jarrod

modes.label: Acronyms and codes
modes.description: A capital I opening an acronym or classification code after a hyphen.

card.writes: It pushes toward word continuations like 'mediate' and 'plementation', as in the start of Im- or Ign- words, so little is clear.
card.plain: It marks a capital I that begins a name or acronym in a reference list or byline.
